PODCAST | Curriculum in action: Exploring Sylvia Park School’s history trail

Check out the Education Gazette's first ever podcast episode!

Staff and students from Auckland’s Sylvia Park School talk about their inquiry, ‘Our Aotearoa’, as they give Education Gazette a tour of their history trail, a product of their inquiry.

Listen to other episodes at: https://educationgazette.podbean.com/

Exam Day Vlog

Hey there, 

So I thought it could be useful for you to see what it is like the day of an exam at university, so you know what to expect. In this vlog, I show my day and how I get ready to sit my marketing exam. I am also dyslexic, and that is why you will see in this that I have my exam in a separate room with a reader-writer. I hope you guys enjoy the vlog, and if you have any questions feel free to let me know!

- Olivia Hubber
